Bill.BriefDescription: Offering health benefit subsidies for certain retired public employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to offering health benefit subsidies for certainretired public employees; and adding a new section to chapter 41.05RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) From September 1, 2011, through August 31, 2014, the healthcare authority shall provide an optional subsidy of two hundred fiftydollars per month for health benefit premiums to any member of plan 1of the teachers' retirement system who: (a) Is ineligible for medicare; (b) Applies for retirement under RCW 41.32.480 between June 1,2011, and August 31, 2011; and (c) Receives the first installment of a retirement allowance asprovided under RCW 41.32.480 before October 31, 2011. (2) Members who opt to receive the subsidy provided in this sectionare ineligible for the postretirement employment provisions of RCW41.32.570 (2) or (3) until August 31, 2014. For the purposes of thissection, employment with an employer also includes any personal service p. 1 SB 5846contract, service by an employer as a temporary or project employee, orany other similar compensated relationship with any employer includedunder the provisions of RCW 41.32.800(1).
